facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 70°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Hogg Pass (4,800 ft) 43 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Hogg Pass
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 8 (2025)

facts.text: At Hogg Pass (4,800 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.8 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Hogg Pass
evidence.detail: 1.8 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 25.3 in (2023), 17.3 in (2024), 25.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 14 and April 26, carried from the melt-out date at Hogg Pass (4,800 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Hogg Pass
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, at the pass elevation; points to March 14 to April 26
